translations.answer: The public implementation for this thread cannot be used in this manner. The original post's conversion code will fold multi-dimensional `geom_dataid` into a single line; the maintainers also explicitly state that batched `geom_dataid` is not planned to be integrated into MJX, and they note that the collision driver may need reworking under JIT static analysis. The author only mentions a local monkey patch, without publishing a patch or results, so it cannot be considered a reusable solution.
translations.applicability: Applies to the MJX-Warp conversion path described in this thread; further implementations in subsequent versions must be rechecked.
translations.credibility.rationale: There is engineering record for the environment, processing steps, and results, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is lacking.
translations.details.attempts.0: The author mentions a local monkey patch but does not provide public results, a patch, or replication data; therefore, it is not registered as a valid fix.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Check if the shape of `geom_dataid` is folded into a single line before the Warp is applied, and record the actual world usage of each `data id`.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: The thread does not contain a merged fix; the capability is currently considered unsupported, and minimal verification should be done before selecting an alternative architecture or submitting a self-contained PR.
translations.details.environments.0: mujoco.mjx and impl=warp; the post is based on a public implementation from 2026-05, without a published version number.
translations.details.limits.0: The two-dimensional field capabilities of the underlying MuJoCo Warp are not equivalent to the front-end MJX exposing these capabilities; the post also does not verify the correctness of any monkey patch.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Issue is closed since the functionality is not in the plan; the maintainers allow a sufficiently small and clean PR to be submitted, but no commitment to receiving it is made.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Can MJX-Warp use batched `geom_dataid` to let each parallel world select a different hfield?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Sampling and printing of each environment's terrain ID or geometric statistics before training is recommended to prevent domain randomization from failing silently.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The maintainers state that the MJX collision driver uses `geom_dataid` as a NumPy array during JIT static analysis; support for dynamic batched fields may require reworking.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Multi-dimensional `geom_dataid` is folded into a single line in `_put_model_warp`, and all worlds receive the same mapping.
translations.source.title: MJX-Warp cannot use batched geom_dataid to route each environment's hfield.
translations.terms.0: Batched geom_dataid (批量几何数据标识)
translations.title: Can batched geom_dataid be assigned in MJX-Warp's parallel environment, allowing each world to use a different hfield?
